verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a native CRM integration with HubSpot, Salesforce, or Attio, or any automatic syncing of notes and summaries onto contact or deal records. The Developer API, webhooks, and MCP server are developer building blocks a team could use to build such a sync, which earns no credit. The axis clearly applies to a meeting-notes product, so the verdict is none rather than na.
